relationships.subject: cannabidiol
relationships.evidence_quote: CBD promoted an antihyperalgesic effect in both phases.

relationships.subject: AM281
relationships.evidence_quote: AM281 reversed the effect of CBD, whereas ruthenium red abolished the late phase.

key_findings: Ischemia-reperfusion did not change CB1 or CB2 immunocontent in mouse paw muscle in a CRPS-I model.
Local CBD was antihyperalgesic, reversed by CB1 antagonist AM281.
